content:
sam-release: FYI: target deploy tonight 23:45 UTC. api@v1.10.0, runtime@2.13.0, router@3.6.0. Console needs proxy header X-Canary and optional X-Sticky.
ivy-runtime: Runtime change: new prefetch path + hot-kernel opt. Batching disabled by default, opt-in via `runtime.batch=true`. We'll ship with batching off for canary.
tom-router: Router 3.6.0 adds sticky session logic. If X-Sticky missing we fall back. Need console to set both headers for canary.
meera-console: Can do. Will open branch PR and a tiny hotfix in proxy. PR: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4377 (preview up).
raj-eng: Recommend pinning before first two waves. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.35% sustained 5m OR regen p95 > +18% for 5m -> rollback runtime only. Thermostat: cpu throttling > 88% auto-hold.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by sam-release for 23:45 UTC. Waves: 8% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Pin queued. Observers: ivy-runtime, tom-router, meera-console.
sam-release: Pin command before first wave: `/deploy pin api@v1.10.0 runtime@2.13.0 router@3.6.0 --note "canary pin 23:45"`
deploy-bot: Pin command queued: `/deploy pin api@v1.10.0 runtime@2.13.0 router@3.6.0`. Please confirm.
ivy-runtime: :thumbsup:
tom-router: :thumbsup:
meera-console: :thumbsup:
raj-eng: Added synthetic regen job at 1s cadence to canary monitors.
meera-console: Proxy PR merged to hotfix branch. Will toggle header only for canary token.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (8%) started at 23:45:12 UTC. Monitors enabled: latency, 5xx, sticky misses, cpu throttle, mem pressure.
ivy-runtime: Wave1 looks fine. Prefetch cold-misses expected. Batching OFF.
tom-router: Sticky header present. No connection churn.
meera-console: Logs show X-Canary and X-Sticky set for canary requests.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 (25%) started at 23:52:02 UTC.
ivy-runtime: At 25% regen p95 +11% vs baseline, p50 +4%. 5xx at 0.12%.
raj-eng: OK to proceed to 60% after 8m hold.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (60%) started at 00:01:40 UTC.
ivy-runtime: At 60% p95 creeping to +19%. Synthetic probes show occasional 502s but still under 0.3% overall.
raj-eng: Keep strict watch. If p95 hits +20% or 5xx >0.35% for 5m we rollback.
meera-console: Noting one canary route with missing X-Sticky ~0.6% of canary traffic; router fallback OK.
tom-router: We'll escalate if sticky misses >1.5%.
deploy-bot: Hold window 6m before final.
ivy-runtime: p95 just touched +20% for a 2m window but not 5m sustained. 5xx still 0.28%.
raj-eng: Decision: continue to 100% but keep runtime pinned for +20m. If 5xx breaches threshold in next 10m rollback runtime.
sam-release: Proceeding to 100% at 00:12:05 UTC.
deploy-bot: Wave 4 (100%) started at 00:12:05 UTC.
ivy-runtime: After 100% p95 settled to +16% baseline. Regen errors fell back. KV pressure normal.
meera-console: Release note draft: "runtime v2.13.0: prefetch path enabled (opt-in), batching default OFF; console proxy adds X-Canary/X-Sticky for canary". Link: https://go/release-notes/2.13.0
sam-release: Unpin proposal: unpin api/router now, keep runtime pinned +20m.
deploy-bot: Executing `/deploy unpin api router`. Runtime pinned until 00:32:05 UTC.
raj-eng: We'll run a quick rollback drill this Friday to validate thermostat auto-hold and fast rollback.
sam-release: Thanks team. I'll post final release note in #release-notes once runtime unpin is cleared. :tada:
